crossRefs.note: Now therefore listen to Yahweh’s word: ‘You say, Don’t prophesy against Israel, and don’t preach against the house of…
Micaiah said, “Therefore hear Yahweh’s word. I saw Yahweh sitting on his throne, and all the army of heaven standing by…
Hear Yahweh’s word, you rulers of Sodom! Listen to the law of our God, you people of Gomorrah!
Therefore hear Yahweh’s word, you scoffers, that rule this people in Jerusalem:
‘Hear this now, foolish people without understanding, who have eyes, and don’t see, who have ears, and don’t hear:
Then the prophet Jeremiah said to Hananiah the prophet, “Listen, Hananiah! Yahweh has not sent you, but you make this…
Yahweh says: “For three transgressions of Israel, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment; because they have…
Therefore, because you trample on the poor, and take taxes from him of wheat: You have built houses of cut stone, but…
“Because of the oppression of the weak and because of the groaning of the needy, I will now arise,” says Yahweh; “I…
Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and don’t call on Yahweh?
Be merciful to me, God, for man wants to swallow me up. All day long, he attacks and oppresses me.
I know that Yahweh will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and justice for the needy.
There is a generation whose teeth are like swords, and their jaws like knives, to devour the poor from the earth, and…
For the fool will speak folly, and his heart will work iniquity, to practice profanity, and to utter error against…
The ways of the scoundrel are evil. He devises wicked plans to destroy the humble with lying words, even when the needy…
“But woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! Because you shut up the Kingdom of Heaven against men; for you…
You have condemned and you have murdered the righteous one. He doesn’t resist you.

translations.web: Hear this, you who desire to swallow up the needy, and cause the poor of the land to fail,
translations.bsb: Hear this, you who trample the needy, who do away with the poor of the land,
translations.kjv: Hear this, O ye that swallow up the needy, even to make the poor of the land to fail,
translations.asv: Hear this, O ye that would swallow up the needy, and cause the poor of the land to fail,
